name: Cycle Anudaan Yojana
benefit: Financial Assistance : 90 percent of actual expenditure or ₹4,000/- whichever is less.
eligibility_rules: Applicant must be a registered construction worker of the division with a valid identity card. Applicant can get the scheme benefits only at once. Applicant must working as registered construction workers for 3 consecutive years. Bicycle purchased on a grant will be prohibited from sale for 3 years.
documents_required: Prescribed application form, Labor registration card/copy. Cycle purchase bill
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline The applicant has to submit the application form in the prescribed format and within the time limit to the office of the designated officer. Rural Area - Chief Executive Officer, Janpad PanchayatUrban Area - Commissioner, Municipal Corporation/Chief Municipal Officer, Municipality/Municipal CouncilApply durationWithin 03 months from the date of purchase of the cycle.
